aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政治领域。热点议题包括：Meta legal action forces Facebook；Former UUP leader Doug Beattie；Dozens killed in explosives depot。本日共收录 6 条重要国际新闻。

articles.title: Meta legal action forces Facebook whistleblower to sit in silence at Hay festival
articles.description: Sarah Wynn-Williams did not speak during event after lawyers warned of possible sanctions from tech firm

articles.title: Former UUP leader Doug Beattie leaves party over ‘toxic atmosphere’
articles.description: MLAs ‘marginalised, ignored, isolated and discredited’ by new leader, Beattie says in statement

articles.title: Dozens killed in explosives depot blast in northeast Myanmar
articles.description: At least 46 people have been killed and 70 wounded in explosion in rebel-held area, local media report.

articles.title: QatarEnergy raises June sulphur price to $805/t fob
articles.description: State-owned QatarEnergy Marketing has raised its June Qatar Sulphur Price (QSP) by $65/t to $805/t fob Ras Laffan/Mesaieed.

articles.title: The false economy of ignoring climate adaptation
articles.description: The imperative to adapt to climate change offers governments a historic opportunity to leapfrog development and financing deficits to upgrade marginalised communities using alternative approaches.
